主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. released its financial results for the fourth quarter of 2013 and the full year ended December 31, 2013 on January 29, 2014. The press release, which is included as Exhibit 99.1, outlines the company's financial performance during these periods. The report is part of a Form 8-K filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The information provided in the report is not considered "filed" under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference into any filings under the Securities Act of 1933, unless explicitly stated. The press release details the company's financial condition and results of operations for the specified periods. The report was signed by Richard L. Bergmark, the Chief Financial Officer of Core Laboratories N.V.
